lifecycle.source_annotation: in drupal:9.3.0 and is removed from drupal:10.0.0. Use \Drupal::entityTypeManager()->getStorage('taxonomy_term')->loadByProperties(['name' => $name, 'vid' => $vid]) instead, to get a list of taxonomy term entities having the same name and keyed by their term ID.
